# Getting started

Ready to try the Kotlin Toolchain? Choose the right approach for you:

- [Examples on GitHub](https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/tree/release/0.12/examples)  Look at complete example projects, and get inspired.
- [Tutorial](tutorial/)  Create a project from the ground up, step-by-step.
- [User guide](../user-guide/)  Learn about the Kotlin Toolchain concepts, or deepen your knowledge about specific topics.
- Start from a template project  Use `./kotlin init` from the [CLI](../cli/#installation), or create a new Kotlin project in IntelliJ IDEA.

> **Good tooling rocks!**

If you choose to write code on your machine, we recommend using IntelliJ IDEA to make the most out of the Kotlin Toolchain. Check our [IDE setup](ide-setup/) page for more information.
